long_description.before:
Supadock builds AI workers for logistics operations. In freight, every call, document, and signature exists to prove diligence — not just save time. Check calls, proof-of-delivery reconciliations, ID verification, and invoice audits all ensure compliance, reduce liability, and protect margins.

Supadock automates these high-accountability workflows while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and risk reduction. Our AI agents use cameras, voice, email, and document processing to handle tasks like verifying driver IDs, coordinating warehouse entry, assigning shipments to carriers, checking freight status, reconciling pickup and delivery paperwork, and following up on late invoices.
long_description.after:
Physical operations still run on fragmented data, manual guard shacks, and paper lists that are difficult to verify. In yards and cross-docks across North America, facilities face surging cargo theft, strict compliance requirements (like CTPAT audits), and expensive labor bottlenecks. Moving from messy gate logs and high-risk manual workflows to fast, secure, autonomous access control usually requires breaking legacy systems or throwing more labor at the problem.

Supadock is the multi-agent AI platform for physical logistics operations. We help 3PLs, logistics businesses, and fleets automate facility workflows—starting with the gate. Our agents make sense of visitor credentials, validate documents via bank-grade KYC, identify security gaps, and automate the SOPs needed to secure facility perimeters 24/7, while keeping human oversight for operational exceptions.

Under the hood, Supadock is a multi-modal learning engine. We connect intelligence across your entire facility stack—orchestrating phone calls, emails, text messages, documents, cameras, access control gates, and TMS APIs. The system captures live operational context that compounds into a living model of your business, bringing multi-agent AI into physical logistics operations one SOP at a time.

one_liner.after: Multi-agent AI for physical logistics operations

Our AI Agent runs the entire international trade operation: handles customs processes with government agencies and regulators, orchestrates cross-border payments, and provides credit solutions for trade finance.

 Built by Codexa, a Central Bank–licensed FX bank, the agent allows exporters and importers to move goods and money seamlessly across borders. 

Today it powers +USD 2b in annual volume across +17.000 transactions, cutting costs and eliminating regulatory friction.
long_description.after:
Our agents run tax, customs clearance, and supply chain workflows, helping companies navigate complex regulations and reduce the cost of international trade. By running these operations, Codexa becomes the natural platform for customers’ payments and foreign exchange.

We execute transactions through our own financial institution, regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil, connecting operational workflows directly to financial infrastructure. Customers approve payments, and Codexa moves the money through traditional and stablecoin rails.

Today, 51 enterprise customers use our agents, and 84% have adopted our financial products. We process approximately $800M in monthly financial volume, including $160M settled through stablecoins. Our customers include Fortune 500 and Global 500 companies.

long_description.after:
AiSDR builds Ami, an AI sales agent that helps B2B companies find customers and book meetings.

Give Ami your website. It researches your business, recommends who to target and why now, and builds an outreach plan. Once you approve, it runs personalized campaigns across email and LinkedIn, follows up, handles replies, and books meetings.

Ami keeps working after launch. It monitors results, spots problems with targeting or messaging, and recommends changes or applies them within the rules you set. It remembers your decisions and campaign results, so each campaign builds on the last.

long_description.before:
The physical economy still operates without a shared intelligence layer. Every day, millions of trucks move goods while carrying unused capacity, yet no system has a real-time understanding of where capacity exists, how freight should move, or how efficiently the supply chain is operating.

Oway is building that layer by indexing live unused truck capacity and exposing it through APIs and AI agents, transforming fragmented transportation into programmable infrastructure that shippers, brokers, carriers, and software platforms can build on.

Today, Oway replaces traditional LTL by moving freight directly on trucks already traveling in the right direction. This reduces costs, damage, and transit times while increasing utilization across the supply chain.

Every shipment strengthens a live model of freight capacity, pricing, routes, facilities, and industrial efficiency. As the network grows, Oway becomes the intelligence and execution layer for the physical economy, enabling the next generation of enterprise software, autonomous supply chains, robotics, and physical AI.
long_description.after:
The physical economy still operates without a common language. Enterprise systems, factories, trucks, and robots generate enormous amounts of data, but most remains fragmented across legacy software and incompatible formats. Without a shared understanding of what is happening, even the most advanced AI cannot reliably coordinate how goods are made, moved, and delivered.

Oway is building that common language. Our protocol, IOI, connects enterprise systems and physical hardware, cleaning messy legacy data and live telemetry into a standardized schema that AI can understand and act on. Through a shared API, businesses can query their operations, identify inefficiencies, and automate actions across systems without replacing their existing software.

Our first model, Juno, applies this intelligence to unused truck capacity. It tracks empty space on trucks and sells it at a 50% discount to businesses shipping in the same direction. By moving freight directly on trucks already making the trip, Oway reduces shipping costs, damage, and transit times while generating additional revenue for carriers.

Every connected system and shipment expands our understanding of capacity, pricing, routes, facilities, and industrial operations. As this network grows, Oway is building toward a future where enterprise software, automated factories, self-driving vehicles, and robots can communicate and coordinate through one shared layer, making the physical economy programmable.

one_liner.before: Turning America’s supply chain inefficiency into infrastructure.
one_liner.after: The coordination OS for the physical economy.

long_description.before:
Rebulk accurately measures and monitors bulk inventory like piles of feed, sand, and other assets that do not fit into boxes and barcodes using cameras, LiDAR, and computer vision.

Most bulk inventory is still managed with rough estimates, manual checks, delayed updates, and too much guesswork. Because it lives in piles, bays, yards, and truck beds instead of boxes with barcodes, it is much harder to track accurately. When teams do not know what is actually on site, it leads to shrink, stockouts, bad planning, and unnecessary fire drills.

We’ve lived this problem, and we know how to solve it. Warren saw it firsthand as a Product Manager at Milk Moovement, a $20M Series A AgTech startup, working closely with feed suppliers and farm managers. Cole was engineer #3 at Tropic, scaling it from seed to Series B, and later led engineering at an AI startup.

We’ve built an integrated hardware and software platform and is working with one of the largest agricultural company in North America and Charm Industrial. As industries demand real-time visibility into the physical world, RebuIk is positioned to become the operating system for bulk assets from inventory tracking to procurement and logistics.
long_description.after:
Rebulk builds AI-native software for rail, transload, and bulk operations. We help teams manage railcars and trucks, transloading, maintenance, yard switching, railcar tracking, bulk inventory, documents, customer reporting, and billing.

Much of this work still runs on spreadsheets, paper tickets, phone calls, and disconnected legacy systems. That means teams spend too much time entering the same information twice, tracking down paperwork, figuring out where railcars and inventory are, and putting together reports by hand. Rebulk brings that work into modern software built around how each business actually operates.

We’ve lived this problem, and we know how to build for it. Warren previously led product at a Series A supply chain software startup, where he worked closely with companies moving and managing bulk commodities. Cole was engineer #3 at Tropic, helping scale it from seed to Series B, and later led engineering at an AI startup.

Rebulk runs operations at Venezia Transport, Usher Transport, Cicada Logistics, McDonald Farms, and TransloadX across transloading, rail maintenance, switching, railcar tracking, and bulk inventory.

one_liner.before: Accurately measure and monitor bulk inventory
one_liner.after: AI-native software for managing rail and bulk operations.

Play Health is building a perimenopause care platform to provide women and their providers with the tools they need to relieve symptoms fast. It is led by technical, second-time, YC-backed founders Andrea Mazzocchi, PhD and Ian Miller, with an exit and a unicorn between them.

Over 30 million women in the U.S. are experiencing perimenopause symptoms, spending an estimated $15B+ annually on symptom management.  Despite this most only receive generic solutions and struggle to find effective symptom relief.

We're bringing evidence-based perimenopause care to women through partnerships with medical practices and employer and health benefits programs. Our platform integrates personalized symptom, medication, and lifestyle data to generate AI-powered insights and  clinical protocols, enabling providers to deliver specialized care.

Every clinical interaction enriches our longitudinal dataset allowing us to create better outcomes for patients, deeper insights for providers, and expand into women’s health broadly. This also enables us to partner with pharma and biotech companies developing therapeutics and diagnostics for women's health.

long_description.before:
**Problem**

Humans used to need laptops to do their work. Now they prompt agents instead, and those agents need computers too: always-on, in large quantities, and with unlimited capabilities. 

Building and maintaining that yourself is far from trivial.

**Solution**

Box provides powerful, simple, permissive Ubuntu VMs in the cloud. In a box, an agent can work for long periods on code or on knowledge work like legal, research, reporting, and auditing.

**Why Box and not any other cloud VM?**

1. It is ready out of the box: every box ships with a desktop, chrome, languages, docker, snapshots, and templates, plus a CLI, SDK, API, and control pane for your fleet.
2. It is permissive and paradigm agnostic: any number of agents can use any number of boxes. Agents can run inside or use boxes as an external tool.
3. It is expertly crafted: we manage everything from the individual CPU to the orchestration software, which makes boxes stable, persistent, scalable, and secure.
4. It is the best performance and price in town: our CPUs rank first on HPC benchmarks, and boxes are typically 9x to 18x cheaper than other leading sandboxes.

**Further notes**

Boxes are hosted in Europe, which keeps prices low, and more regions are coming. Unless compliance requires it, agents don't notice the region they run in.
